reviewed_by: Delegated coding agent static review against live Binary Ninja 6.0.10601 MCP (retail PE view_1), radare2 6.2.0 CFG and angr 10.0.4.post1 CFGFast on retail igi.exe; candidate source read from this worktree. No game process was executed and no runtime behavior is claimed.
review_basis: Retail 0x004A9CA0 was re-disassembled, re-decompiled and re-CFG'd through the live Binary Ninja view, independently recovered with radare2 6.2.0 and angr 10.0.4.post1 CFGFast. The candidate is scripts/GameNatives/camera/004A9CA0-Camera_ResetMatrix_17.cpp at sha256 863c419ee6cc14092eddb35d8c81a194a0b6dd9ab1676becf71c9e90f53ca704 (recorded implementation.signature: long double Camera_ResetMatrix_17(long param_1);). The evidence artifact digests are bound in this review.

retail_function.name: Camera_ResetMatrix_17
retail_function.summary: Single block 0x4A9CA0-0x4A9CB4: x87 2^x computed as roundl(st0) -> fsubr/fxch/fchs/f2xm1 -> +1 -> fscale -> fstp st1; returns st0.

candidate_function.summary: __twoToTOS(long double context) reproduces roundl, the f2xm1 argument, the +1 and fscale exactly, returning the same x87 result.

divergences: Argument is delivered on the cdecl stack instead of in st0 (retail 0x4A9CA0 begins with `fld st0, st0`, i.e. it duplicates the incoming st0).
candidate_comparison.statement: Divergences are listed above; by contract they keep the record at TRANSCRIBED or lower.

checks.name: function_identity
checks.detail: Retail entry 0x004A9CA0 is recovered by all three tools; the address-bound implementation is scripts/GameNatives/camera/004A9CA0-Camera_ResetMatrix_17.cpp (sha256 863c419ee6cc14092eddb35d8c81a194a0b6dd9ab1676becf71c9e90f53ca704). Single block 0x4A9CA0-0x4A9CB4: x87 2^x computed as roundl(st0) -> fsubr/fxch/fchs/f2xm1 -> +1 -> fscale -> fstp st1; returns st0. Candidate: __twoToTOS(long double context) reproduces roundl, the f2xm1 argument, the +1 and fscale exactly, returning the same x87 result.

checks.name: abi_and_signature
checks.detail: Retail consumes the argument from st0 (`fld st0, st0` duplicates the incoming st0) and returns the result in st0; BN models the signature as `long double(long double arg1 @ st0)`. The candidate declares an ordinary cdecl `long double __twoToTOS(long double context)`, which passes the argument on the stack, not in st0.

checks.name: argument_mapping
checks.detail: The single argument is st0 in retail; the candidate's `context` is a cdecl stack parameter at [E+4].

checks.name: control_flow_shape
checks.detail: Binary Ninja and radare2 agree on 1 blocks / 0 edges (similarity 1.000); angr CFGFast recovers 1 blocks with has_unresolved_jumps=false.

checks.name: calls_and_side_effects
checks.detail: No calls in retail or candidate.

checks.name: constants_and_scaling
checks.detail: No immediate numeric constants; the x87 sequence is reproduced op-for-op.

checks.name: memory_layout_and_access
checks.detail: No memory reads or writes in either version.

checks.name: return_and_error_paths
checks.detail: Both return the computed x87 value in st0.

checks.name: floating_point_semantics
checks.detail: The x87 stack choreography (fxch/fchs/f2xm1/fld1/faddp/fscale/fstp st1) and the C1 rounding-mode behaviour match; only the argument delivery differs.

signature_comparison.rationale: Binary Ninja reports "long double(long double arg1 @ st0)" at 0x004A9CA0; radare2 recovers "fcn.004a9ca0 ();". Both tools place the entry at 0x004A9CA0 and agree on the stack/register word count and cleanup; the difference is the level of type/argument-name detail, not the call frame. Candidate declaration: long double Camera_ResetMatrix_17(long param_1);. The candidate declaration is separately recorded as divergent below and does not satisfy the retail ABI.

limitations: No game process was executed; this review is static (live Binary Ninja, radare2 CFG, angr CFGFast) plus the candidate source.
The candidate defines __twoToTOS, not the catalog name Camera_ResetMatrix_17.
